footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss to Hut 8: includes a $51.8M income tax benefit, $21.8M of losses allocated to noncontrolling interests.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue rose 44.8% to $235M in 2025. Gross margin was 54.2%, versus 46.6% a year earlier, and the company had an operating loss of $322M, versus operating income of $461M.
The company had a net loss of $226M, or −$2.14 per share, versus net income of $332M. Operating cash flow was −$139M and free cash flow −$342M, versus −$193M.
sources: Hut 8 Corp. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
